Name: (CP and AT) Romantic Ranch Buildings
Author: allaviyu
Description:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/rK1ZK30f/intro.png[/img]
[center]
[color=#f9cb9c][size=4][i]A tiny place where all the stories begin...

You, who opened your late grandfather's letter, received this overgrown lot
in the middle of the Valley. Your new home; an old, dilapidated farmhouse,
reminiscent of the cozy warmth you remember in your younger years.

Among the various buildings it once accompanied was this rickety coop
[/i][/size][/color][color=#f9cb9c][size=4][i]that once housed various little friends you remember chasing, a barn filled
of noisy companions you orchestrate with to complete that one kids' song,
a towering silo with a pulley you remember playing in as princess with long
hair that's stuck in the tower-- though grandpa scolded you for it countlessly,
and this lone stable for the mighty steed you remember that your grandfather
used to take you around Stardew Valley.

Equipped with old memories full of nostalgia, maybe it's time to meet
new animal friends.



[/i][/size][/color][/center][center]━─━────━─━──── ˋˏ ༻❁༺ ˎˊ ━─━────━─━────﻿[/center]
[size=5]                      ﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/7xyVnBch/label.png[/img][/size]
[quote][i]NOTE: YOU CAN CHOOSE ONE VERSION: If CP, download the CP file, if AT, download the AT file; OR BOTH VERSIONS.[/i][/quote][size=3]

[*]Download the [u]AT version[/u] file and unzip it in your 'Mods' folder.
[/list]

[list]
[*](AT) There are multiple variations for each building per season. You can change for either using the paint bucket tool you can buy form Robin for AT.
[*](CP) You can choose between seasonal or non-seasonal in config or in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.
[*]The Non-seasonal variants are the Summer designs!
[*]Hello! This is part of the matching building set for my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30738]French Country Farmhouse[/url]! I decided to separate it into 4 parts to work easily.
[*]It's [b]Ranch, Farm, Mystical, and Cabins.[/b]
[*][b]Ranch [/b]consists of all [b]animal buildings except for the pond[/b]. The pet houses and bowls may come in a different part or a Miscellaneous part.
[*]I'll try to update as soon as I can but for now I hope you enjoy!
[/list]
